verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform documents an API for listing deployments, projects and findings, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the pack contains no evidence of an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. llms.txt and SARIF output are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
